notes.title: Player Walk Speed Increased
notes.content:
I've slightly increased the player's walking speed based on your feedback.



Thank you all for sharing your thoughts! I’ll continue striving to make this game the best it can be, and every lesson learned here will help shape my future projects!

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Increased the frequency of lightning strikes in Chapter 2 to improve visibility during stealth sequences.

Tweaked AI audio cues in Chapter 2 to make it easier to gauge enemy positioning.



Hope these changes enhance your experience—and as always, thank you for the continued support!

notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content:
Certain key items will now emit a subtle glow by default, making them easier to spot without needing to be directly observed first.

Addressed an issue where the mouse cursor could drift while navigating menus. While I was unable to reproduce this during extensive playtesting, this update includes a potential fix.

 Thank you for all the support!

notes.title: HEADING TOWARDS A RELEASE DATE!!!
notes.content:
Here’s what’s next on our agenda:
    
1.    ✅ Let my other tester play through and confirm bugs are fixed.
    
2.    💪 Push myself to the limit to implement Steam achievements.

3.    🕹️ Test the game with a controller.

4.    🎬 Work on a fresh, eye-catching trailer that really shows off what I’ve built.

5.    📅 Announce the official release date and price.

6.    📢 Promote, Promote, Promote! 🚀

Let’s keep the momentum going!🙌
